hero.headline: Shaping the Future of AI. Rooted in Dortmund.
hero.subheadline: Join the Ruhr region's premier network for students, builders, and young professionals driving the next wave of Artificial Intelligence.
hero.title: Young AI Leaders - Dortmund Hub
hero.intro: As a local community under the UN AI for Good platform, we empower young minds to drive positive change with AI. We are active on {{linkedin}}, {{discord}}, {{instagram}}, and {{tiktok}}! Currently we analyze the {{election}} Meet us at the {{christmas}} or at the {{seminar}}
hero.call: Are you into AI and believe that it should be used for good? Do you want to connect with other forward-thinkers and join our {{collaboration}}? Then apply now and {{apply}}

info.title: Additional Information
info.description1: Through initiatives like the Young AI Leaders Community, AI for Good ensures that young people have the skills, platforms, and support to lead the way in building a more inclusive and sustainable digital future. We are proud to be one of 90 hubs around the world, putting AI to good use in the area of Dortmund! For more information and projects, please refer to the {{charter}} and {{homepage}}
info.description2: We explicitly welcome folks from any background - diversity is a central strength of our community! This means that anyone aged 18-30 can apply to become a Young AI Leader for up to four years. Apply via the {{form}} - click "APPLY TO JOIN A HUB" and select the Dortmund Hub!
info.description3: Our Hub is currently led by {{raphael}}, {{nico}} and {{bahavathy}}. We are happy about support and feedback of any kind - thank you!

about.label: ABOUT
about.headline: Explore ideas.
about.description1: Young AI Leaders Dortmund exists to bring together the next generation shaping artificial intelligence. We are building a place where people explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and turn promising conversations into meaningful work.
about.description2: We do this through a focused local hub: regular meetups, relevant events, practical exchange, and a membership structure designed to bring the right people into the room.
about.description3: Our goal is simple: make it easier for ambitious people in and around Dortmund, the Ruhr region, to think clearly about AI, technology, and business. Build strong relationships and stay close to the ideas, developments, and opportunities that matter.
